mcp_tools.name: sql_schema_query_engineering_pack
mcp_tools.title: Sql schema query engineering pack
mcp_tools.description: Submits a SQL schema and query engineering record (schema design with declared table rows, index design with declared index rows, declared query rows, query practice, transactions, SQL safety, migrations, performance evidence, red lines) and returns a deterministic SQL_SCHEMA_QUERY_ENGINEERING_PACK_READY / SQL_SCHEMA_QUERY_ENGINEERING_PACK_NOT_READY / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across eight sections, including computed coverage ratios over the declared rows, with per-check evidence. Audits the declared record only; it connects to no database, executes no SQL and reviews no live codebase.

inputSchema.description: The SQL schema & query engineering manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table and row schemas).

expect.notes: All fields set to pass; computed_spot_checks: tables_count=1, indexes_count=1, queries_count=1, table_primary_key_coverage=1.000000
